newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to gain on Wednesday on new accounts day buying, but overall sentiment would remain mixed on lack of support from institutions and genuine investors, dealers said.

"New accounts day buying could push the index up by 10 points or so, but there is no genuine interest," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "Investors lack confidence because of Pakistan's weak economic fundamentals."
On Tuesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 8.24 points, or 0.53 percent, to end at 1,545.41. Losers outnumbered advancers by 168 to 94.
Turnover fell to 30.44 million shares from 48.33 million in the previous session.
